---
title: geom-hline
subtitle: Horizontal reference line at one or more y intercepts.
category: Geoms
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


`yintercept` can be a scalar or an array. The layer does not inherit the
plot mapping by default; it draws purely from the `yintercept` parameter.

## Usage

```typst
geom-hline(
  yintercept: none,
  colour: rgb("#888888"),
  stroke: 0.6pt,
  alpha: 1,
  inherit-aes: false,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `yintercept` | `none` | Scalar or array of y values at which to draw horizontal lines. |
| `colour` | `rgb("#888888")` | Line colour. |
| `stroke` | `0.6pt` | Line thickness (a Typst length). |
| `alpha` | `1` | Line opacity in `[0, 1]`. |
| `inherit-aes` | `false` | Whether to merge the plot-level mapping into this layer's mapping. Defaults to `false`. |

## Returns

Layer dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/geom-hline-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (x: i, y: i + 2))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (
    geom-point(size: 2pt),
    geom-hline(yintercept: 5, colour: rgb("#cc0000")),
  ),
)
```

## See also

[`geom-vline`](geom-vline.qmd), [`geom-abline`](geom-abline.qmd).
